title: A hierarchical federated learning method with adaptive compression coding
assignee: Hunan University of Science and Technology

pse.problem: Inefficient and asynchronous training in hierarchical federal learning methods lead to accumulation and amplification of deviations or errors, affecting the use of the method.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a self-adaptive compression coding method that constructs a hierarchical federal learning architecture. It evaluates data processing performance indexes of each terminal device, matches edge servers according to predefined performance index intervals, collects environmental data, generates an environmental data training model for each terminal device, monitors network transmission performance indexes of each input end of the edge servers, matches compression rates, aggregates models based on compression rates and cloud service quality, and judges global quality of the cloud service.
pse.solution_structure: The structure consists of multiple terminal devices, edge servers, a cloud platform for environmental data storage, and a hierarchical federal learning architecture. The architecture includes input ends of the edge servers and a cloud service.
pse.solution_implementation: The method starts by constructing the hierarchical federal learning architecture. It then acquires data processing related information of each terminal device, evaluates their performance indexes, matches edge servers based on predefined performance index intervals, collects environmental data from the cloud platform, generates an environmental data training model for each terminal device, monitors network transmission performance indexes of each input end of the edge servers, matches compression rates, aggregates models based on compression rates and cloud service quality, and judges global quality of the cloud service.
pse.effect: This method reduces deviations or errors in training by adapting compression coding to improve the synchronization and efficiency of hierarchical federal learning.
